name: The Enchanter
fieldReading: Beauty is a frequency. Broadcast it.
bio: A weaver of beauty who turns bare ground enchanted — to whom beauty is not decoration but the work itself.
sceneStory: Crossing a cracked grey wasteland, a figure trails a long string of fairy lights from one hand. In the line behind every footstep, glowing flowers are bursting up out of the dead ground and opening.
assignment: Make one plain corner beautiful. People become the magic a place promises them.
